card.title: Top view of HAC-EMMC-01 board with Samsung KLMBG2JENB 32 GB eMMC storage chip

source.title: Nintendo Switch HAC-EMMC-01 Board with Samsung eMMC Chip

claims.statement: The HAC-EMMC-01 board contains the Samsung KLMBG2JENB 32 GB eMMC storage chip used in Nintendo Switch.
claims.evidence: Board text shows 'HAC-EMMC-01' and IC markings show 'SEC 640 B041 KLMBG2JENB S4V32MGFS'.

card.caveats: This is a component identification view showing top side of the board and IC markings. No voltage or diode measurement values are shown.
